name: komorebi-haetsal-pipeline
description: Content pipeline app for こもれび便り (JP) and 햇살 편지 (KR) YouTube channels

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,dashboard -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/dashboard
